name: 4-terpineol + melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree) leaf oil
uses: Use Gently refreshes and hydrates the eye area. Helps soothe dry, tired eyes and remove surface impurities-leaving skin around the eyes feeling clean, comfortable, and moisturized.
otcwarn: Do not use People with allergic constitution, those with rashes or open wounds around the eyes are prohibited from using. Stop Use Stop application if eyes or skin around eyes show signs of redness, irritation or sensitivity and consult your eye care professional.
